summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode. rich/control.py registers the title sequence (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) in CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and adds Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, returning True only when the control was written. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only). Nothing was run or committed, and Black formatting was not verified. The console test's legacy-Windows skip uses sys.platform == "win32" as the reading of "legacy Windows".
